message.content: Investigate why an auto-generated title disappears after Claude compaction.
I am tracing the Claude SessionStart compact lifecycle.
Keep the topic-bearing title stable across compaction.
I will preserve the existing auto title and its provenance.
Manual workspace names must continue to win.
Workspace and panel ownership will be checked independently.
A stale finisher must not clear a newer reconciliation.
The state transition uses generation compare-and-set ownership.
Do not call the model again just to replay a stored title.
The compact hook records a durable replay obligation.
Repair the visible panel projection if it resets to Claude Code.
An idempotent title apply repairs the derived tab chrome.
Verify this through the tagged dev build.
The final SHA will be exercised through the app socket and hook CLI.
